model.about: OpenAI, mixture of experts (3.6B active), MXFP4 as released. The model approved today; the baseline every other profile is read against.

answers.sql:
SELECT d.CHNL_K, d.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d ON f.CHNL_K = d.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND dt.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY d.CHNL_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customers
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT d.JUR_CD1 AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d ON f.JUR_K = d.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY d.JUR_CD1
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d_br.BUS_ID, d_br.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    AND d_br.IS_CURR
  GROUP BY d_br.BUS_ID, d_br.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT * FROM txn ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = (
    SELECT MAX(CAL_DT)
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE CAL_DT <= '2025-08-31' AND IS_MTH_END
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS num_clients_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN last_day ld ON f.BUS_DT_K = ld.DT_K
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT dct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG dct ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = dct.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dct.IS_CURR
GROUP BY dct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  ROUND(AVG(f.MID_RT), 4) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY avg_daily_fx_rate DESC;

SELECT m.DSPLY_NM AS market_name, SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = true
  AND OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

WITH atm AS (
  SELECT b.CTY_NM AS city,
         COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE b.IS_CURR = true
    AND d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
  GROUP BY b.CTY_NM
)
SELECT city, atm_txn_count
FROM atm
ORDER BY city;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1='USD' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR=2025 AND d.MTH_NBR=12;

WITH disputes AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT MTH_NBR, COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM disputes
GROUP BY MTH_NBR
ORDER BY MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH cust_current AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
), txns_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM cust_current c
LEFT JOIN txns_2025 t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
WHERE t.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT f.PMT_STS_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_declined
FROM auth;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON f.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
  WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dd.CAL_DT) = 2025
  GROUP BY f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM, cnt FROM c ORDER BY cnt DESC;

SELECT ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, SUM(t.FEE_AMT) AS total_fee
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON t.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fee DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT <= '2025-12-31'
  AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD';

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM alerts
GROUP BY jurisdiction_name
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_days
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN target_date d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT a.BUS_DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON a.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  WHERE c.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
)
SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT f.LN_PRD_K, f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(t.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM target t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON t.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
WHERE p.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM;

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
    AND c.IS_CURR = true
    AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = true
    AND d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_sme_crossborder_customers FROM transfers;

WITH txn_counts AS (
  SELECT d.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
         d.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON f.BR_K = d.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.RGN_CD1, d.DSPLY_NM
), ranked AS (
  SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY txn_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn_counts
)
SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT a.MRCH_K, a.STLM_AMT, m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON a.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON a.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT MRCH_CTG_CD1, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total
FROM auth
GROUP BY MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT c.BUS_ID, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
)
SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1,
  SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

WITH w AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
  WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.IS_CURR
), a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
  WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.IS_CURR
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM w
WHERE w.CUST_K IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM a);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH d AS (SELECT DT_K, CAL_YR_NBR FROM bank_dwh.D_DT) SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfers FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025) GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_DT AS txn_date
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_count
FROM txn t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.txn_date = d.CAL_DT;

WITH bal AS (
  SELECT ACCT_K, CLSNG_BAL_AMT, CCY_CD1, BUS_DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT IN ('2025-12-31','2025-06-30')
  )
),
  dec AS (
    SELECT b1.ACCT_K, b1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS bal_12, b2.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS bal_6
    FROM bal b1
    JOIN bal b2 ON b1.ACCT_K = b2.ACCT_K AND b1.CCY_CD1 = b2.CCY_CD1
    WHERE b1.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT='2025-12-31')
      AND b2.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT='2025-06-30')
  )
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM dec
WHERE bal_12 < 0.9 * bal_6;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K,
         d.DSPLY_NM,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT))/86400 AS days
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
  WHERE f.IS_RSLVD = true
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.RSLTN_AT) = 2025
    AND d.IS_CURR = true
)
SELECT CMPLT_CTG_K, DSPLY_NM, AVG(days) AS avg_days
FROM c
GROUP BY CMPLT_CTG_K, DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY avg_days;

WITH curr AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = true
), prev AS (
  SELECT d1.BUS_ID,
         d1.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS prev_seg,
         d2.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS curr_seg
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d1
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d2
    ON d1.BUS_ID = d2.BUS_ID
   AND d1.VRSN_NBR = d2.VRSN_NBR - 1
  WHERE d2.IS_CURR = true
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_changed
FROM prev
WHERE prev_seg <> curr_seg;

WITH txns AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, d.QTR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = true
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM cust c
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM txns t
  WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  GROUP BY t.CUST_K
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.QTR_NBR) = 4
);

WITH disputes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
  WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND d.IS_CURR = true
), transfers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
  WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND d.IS_CURR = true
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM disputes d
LEFT JOIN transfers t ON d.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
WHERE t.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH d2024 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE DYS_PST_DUE = 0
    AND BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2024-06-30')
), d2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE DYS_PST_DUE > 30
    AND BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM d2024
WHERE LN_ID IN (SELECT LN_ID FROM d2025);

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.ORGNL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORGNL_AMT) AS median_amount
FROM transfers
GROUP BY CCY_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr,
         SUM(f.TXN_CNT) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
  GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT (cnt_2025::numeric / NULLIF(cnt_2024,0) - 1)*100 AS pct_growth
FROM (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2024 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_2024,
             MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_2025
      FROM txn) t;

WITH month_ends AS (
  SELECT CAL_DT AS month_end
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE IS_MTH_END AND CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
), balances AS (
  SELECT me.month_end,
         SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing
  FROM month_ends me
  JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON f.BUS_DT_K = (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d WHERE d.CAL_DT = me.month_end
  )
  GROUP BY me.month_end
)
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM month_end)::int AS month,
       total_closing
FROM balances
ORDER BY month_end;

WITH cust2025 AS (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND CUST_SNC_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
), txns2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM cust2025 c
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM txns2025 t WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K);

WITH valid_cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
    AND (EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR EFF_TO_DT > DATE '2023-06-30')
    AND IS_ACTV = TRUE
)
SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM valid_cust
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
         d.BUS_ID,
         SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE d.IS_CURR = true
    AND dt.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND dt.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, d.BUS_ID
)
SELECT segment, BUS_ID, total
FROM (
  SELECT segment, BUS_ID, total,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total DESC) AS rn
  FROM t
) s
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment, rn;

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT CCY_CD1, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY CCY_CD1
), total AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM counts
)
SELECT c.CCY_CD1,
       ROUND(100.0 * c.cnt / t.total_cnt, 2) AS pct
FROM counts c, total t
ORDER BY pct DESC;

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d.CAL_DT) AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS wire_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month,
       wire_cnt,
       SUM(wire_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_total
FROM monthly_counts
ORDER BY month;

WITH wr AS (
  SELECT f.ORGNL_AMT, f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
), fx AS (
  SELECT f.BS_CCY_CD1, f.QUOT_CCY_CD1, f.MID_RT, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K

)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN w.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN w.ORGNL_AMT

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR, d.CAL_YR_NBR,

)
SELECT MTH_NBR,

WITH f AS (

)
SELECT CCY_CD1, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_volume

WITH txn AS (

SELECT * FROM txn;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customers

WITH alerts AS (

  JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K

)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS aml_alerts

ORDER BY aml_alerts DESC;

WITH atm AS (

  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K

)
SELECT BUS_ID, DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count

JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH target_date AS (

)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default

WITH d AS (

)
SELECT d_c.CMPLT_CTG_K,

JOIN d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d_c.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY d_c.CMPLT_CTG_K, d_c.DSPLY_NM;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  ROUND(AVG(f.MID_RT), 8) AS avg_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY avg_daily_rate DESC;

WITH d AS (SELECT DT_K, CAL_YR_NBR FROM bank_dwh.D_DT) SELECT m.BUS_ID AS market_id, m.DSPLY_NM AS market_name, SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY m.BUS_ID, m.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = true
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d.CTY_NM AS city, dt.CAL_YR_NBR, dt.MTH_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON f.BR_K = d.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND dt.MTH_NBR BETWEEN 1 AND 3
)
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

WITH fx AS (
  SELECT f.MID_RT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
    AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT AVG(MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_YR_NBR, MTH_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
)
SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS disputes
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH cust_current AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = true
), txns_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM cust_current c
LEFT JOIN txns_2025 t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
WHERE t.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT f.PMT_STS_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_declined
FROM auth;

WITH escalated AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d_dt.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = true
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d_dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT c.CMPLT_CTG_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints
FROM escalated c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
GROUP BY c.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints DESC;

SELECT dch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, SUM(f.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL dch ON f.CHNL_K = dch.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY dch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1='FRAUD' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR=2025;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.JUR_K, d.DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS high_alert_count
FROM alerts a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY high_alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_days
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31' AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT f.BUS_DT_K, f.TXN_CNT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
)
SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, SUM(txn.TXN_CNT) AS txn_count
FROM txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON txn.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
  p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product,
  SUM(b.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D b
JOIN target_date d ON b.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON b.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
WHERE p.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM;

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = true
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM transfers t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND c.IS_CURR = true;

WITH atm AS (
  SELECT d_br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
         d_br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY d_br.RGN_CD1, d_br.DSPLY_NM
), ranked AS (
  SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY txn_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM atm
)
SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT a.MRCH_K, a.STLM_AMT, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(a.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM auth a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON a.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT c.BUS_ID, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
)
SELECT BUS_ID, total
FROM t
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1,
  SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

),
atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT w.CUST_K

  JOIN atm a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K
) sub;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS cnt

  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K

SELECT year, cnt FROM t ORDER BY year;

WITH txn AS (

)
SELECT

  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_count

WITH bal AS (
  SELECT ACCT_K, CLSNG_BAL_AMT, BUS_DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'

    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
  )
), dec AS (
  SELECT b1.ACCT_K
  FROM bal b1
  JOIN bal b2 ON b1.ACCT_K = b2.ACCT_K
  WHERE b1.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31')

)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts_decreased_more_than_10_percent

WITH resolved AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K,
         f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT,
         f.RSLTN_AT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  WHERE f.IS_RSLVD = true
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.RSLTN_AT) = 2025
)
SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.RSLTN_AT - r.CNTCT_STRTD_AT))/86400),2) AS avg_days
FROM resolved r
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON r.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY avg_days DESC;

WITH txns AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
), custs AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT c.CUST_K
  FROM custs c
  JOIN txns t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
  GROUP BY c.CUST_K
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', t.CAL_DT)) = 4
) q;

WITH disputes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), transfers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM disputes d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transfers t WHERE t.CUST_K = d.CUST_K);

WITH a AS (
  SELECT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2024-06-30')
    AND DYS_PST_DUE = 0
), b AS (
  SELECT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30')
    AND DYS_PST_DUE > 30
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM a
WHERE LN_ID IN (SELECT LN_ID FROM b);

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.ORGNL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORGNL_AMT) AS median_amt
FROM transfers
GROUP BY CCY_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr,
         SUM(f_txn.TXN_CNT) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f_txn
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d_chnl ON f_txn.CHNL_K = d_chnl.CHNL_K

  GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT (cnt_2025::numeric / NULLIF(cnt_2024,0) - 1)*100 AS pct_growth
FROM (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2024 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_2024,
             MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_2025
      FROM txn) t;

WITH month_ends AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    AND IS_MTH_END
)
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM me.CAL_DT)::int AS month,
       SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM month_ends me
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON f.BUS_DT_K = me.DT_K
GROUP BY me.CAL_DT
ORDER BY me.CAL_DT;

WITH cust2025 AS (
  SELECT CUST_K

  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND CUST_SNC_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), txns AS (

  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f

  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-32'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers

)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM t
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY pct DESC;

  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', d.CAL_DT) AS month_start,
         COUNT(*) AS monthly_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT month_start::date AS month,
       monthly_count,
       SUM(monthly_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS running_total
FROM t
ORDER BY month_start;

WITH trf AS (
  SELECT f.ORGNL_AMT, f.CCY_CD1, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT <= '2025-12-31'
), fx AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.BUS_DT_K, f.MID_RT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN trf.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN trf.ORGNL_AMT
                 ELSE trf.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT END) AS total_eur
FROM trf
LEFT JOIN fx ON trf.CCY_CD1 = fx.CCY_CD1 AND trf.CAL_DT = (SELECT d.CAL_DT FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d WHERE d.DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K);

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR,
         COUNT(*) AS total,
         SUM(CASE WHEN a.EVNT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS declined
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT MTH_NBR,
       ROUND(100.0 * declined / NULLIF(total,0), 2) AS decline_pct
FROM auth
ORDER BY decline_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1 AS currency, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM t
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

SELECT ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN ft
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON ft.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON ft.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND ch.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.JUR_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM alerts a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT br.BR_K, br.DSPLY_NM, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT BR_K, DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY BR_K, DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

WITH disputes AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count FROM disputes;

WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN last_day ld ON f.BUS_DT_K = ld.DT_K
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT dcm.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG dcm ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = dcm.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dcm.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE MTH_NBR = 8 AND IS_MTH_END
  ORDER BY DT_K DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
  defaults AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d_cust.BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d_cust ON f.CUST_K = d_cust.CUST_K
    WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
      AND d.DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM last_day)
      AND d_cust.IS_CURR = TRUE
  )
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM defaults;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY avg_daily_rate DESC;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
  m.BUS_ID AS market_id,
  m.DSPLY_NM AS market_name,
  SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY m.BUS_ID, m.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT d.ACCT_TYP_CD1,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.ACCT_K) AS num_accounts
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT d
WHERE d.OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND d.OPND_DT <= '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY d.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY d.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT b.CTY_NM AS city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY b.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

WITH fx AS (
  SELECT f.MID_RT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
    AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT AVG(MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM fx;

WITH disputes AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR, COUNT(*) AS dispute_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT mth_nbr, dispute_cnt
FROM disputes
ORDER BY mth_nbr;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH cust_current AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = true
), txns_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM cust_current c
LEFT JOIN txns_2025 t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
WHERE t.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT f.PMT_STS_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_declined
FROM auth;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, f.IS_ESCLT, d_dt.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
    AND d_dt.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01'
    AND d_dt.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
), c AS (
  SELECT d.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d
  WHERE d.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints_2025
FROM f
JOIN c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints_2025 DESC;

WITH fee AS (
  SELECT f.FEE_AMT, c.DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_FEE f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, SUM(FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM fee
GROUP BY DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees DESC;

SELECT SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1='FRAUD' AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR=2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_days
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31' AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH mobile_chnl AS (
  SELECT CHNL_K FROM bank_dwh.D_CHNL WHERE DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
)
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT)::int AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN mobile_chnl m ON t.CHNL_K = m.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
  d.LN_PRD_K,
  d.DSPLY_NM,
  SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d
  ON f.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
JOIN target_date td
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = td.DT_K
WHERE d.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY d.LN_PRD_K, d.DSPLY_NM;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = true
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
    AND c.IS_CURR = true
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_crossborder_customers
FROM t;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
         br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_count
FROM (
  SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY txn_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn
) t
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT f.MRCH_K, f.STLM_AMT, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(a.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM auth a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON a.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT c.BUS_ID, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
)
SELECT BUS_ID, total
FROM t
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.STLM_AMT, c.CCY_NM AS currency
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT currency, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM t
GROUP BY currency;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM wire
  INTERSECT
  SELECT CUST_K FROM atm
) t;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT year, cnt FROM t ORDER BY year;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_DT, d.IS_WKND
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_count
FROM txn;

WITH bal AS (
  SELECT ACCT_K, BUS_DT_K, CLSNG_BAL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT IN ('2025-12-31','2025-06-30')
  )
), dec AS (
  SELECT a.ACCT_K, a.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS bal_12, b.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS bal_6
  FROM bal a
  JOIN bal b ON a.ACCT_K=b.ACCT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d1 ON a.BUS_DT_K=d1.DT_K AND d1.CAL_DT='2025-12-31'
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON b.BUS_DT_K=d2.DT_K AND d2.CAL_DT='2025-06-30'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM dec
WHERE bal_12 < 0.9 * bal_6;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT
    cm.CMPLT_CTG_K,
    d.DSPLY_NM,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (cm.RSLTN_AT - cm.CNTCT_STRTD_AT))/86400 AS days
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT cm
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON cm.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
  WHERE cm.IS_RSLVD = true
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cm.RSLTN_AT) = 2025
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM, AVG(days) AS avg_days
FROM c
GROUP BY DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY avg_days;

WITH curr AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR
), prev AS (
  SELECT d1.BUS_ID, d1.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d1
  JOIN (
    SELECT BUS_ID, MAX(VRSN_NBR) AS max_prev
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE NOT IS_CURR
    GROUP BY BUS_ID
  ) d2 ON d1.BUS_ID = d2.BUS_ID AND d1.VRSN_NBR = d2.max_prev
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT curr.BUS_ID) AS customers_with_segment_change
FROM curr
JOIN prev USING (BUS_ID)
WHERE curr.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> prev.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH txn_2025 AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
), quarter_counts AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CAL_DT)) AS qtr_cnt
  FROM txn_2025
  GROUP BY CUST_K
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CAL_DT)) = 4
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers
FROM quarter_counts qc
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON qc.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

WITH disputes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
  WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), transfers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
  WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM disputes d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transfers t WHERE t.CUST_K = d.CUST_K);

WITH d2024 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE DYS_PST_DUE = 0
    AND BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2024-06-30')
), d2025 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE DYS_PST_DUE > 30
    AND BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM d2024
WHERE LN_ID IN (SELECT LN_ID FROM d2025);

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.ORGNL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORGNL_AMT) AS median_amt
FROM transfers
GROUP BY CCY_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, SUM(f.TXN_CNT) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT (cnt_2025::numeric / NULLIF(cnt_2024,0) - 1)*100 AS pct_growth
FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2025 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_2025,
             SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2024 THEN cnt END) AS cnt_2024
      FROM txn) t;

WITH month_max AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', d.CAL_DT) AS month_start,
         MAX(d.DT_K) AS max_dt_k
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY month_start
), balances AS (
  SELECT m.month_start,
         SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN month_max m ON d.DT_K = m.max_dt_k
  GROUP BY m.month_start
)
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM month_start)::int AS month,
       total_closing
FROM balances
ORDER BY month_start;

WITH cust2025 AS (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = true
    AND CUST_SNC_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND CUST_SNC_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
), txns2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM cust2025 c
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM txns2025 t WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K);

WITH valid_cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE '2023-06-30'::date >= EFF_FRM_DT
    AND (EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR '2023-06-30'::date <= EFF_TO_DT)
)
SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM valid_cust
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH cust_cur AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = true
), trf AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
), agg AS (
  SELECT c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
         c.BUS_ID,
         SUM(t.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY SUM(t.STLM_AMT) DESC) AS rn
  FROM cust_cur c
  JOIN trf t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
  GROUP BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, c.BUS_ID
)
SELECT segment_code, BUS_ID, total_amount
FROM agg
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, total_amount DESC;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT CCY_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM t
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY pct DESC;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_nbr,
         COUNT(*) AS month_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT month_nbr,
       month_count,
       SUM(month_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_nbr) AS running_total
FROM t
ORDER BY month_nbr;

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT f.STLM_AMT, f.CCY_CD1, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
), rates AS (
  SELECT r.CCY_CD1, r.MID_RT, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D r
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE r.BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN t.STLM_AMT
                ELSE t.STLM_AMT / r.MID_RT END) AS total_eur
FROM transfers t
LEFT JOIN rates r ON t.CCY_CD1 = r.CCY_CD1 AND t.CAL_DT = r.CAL_DT;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS total,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.EVNT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS declined
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT month, ROUND(100.0 * declined / total, 2) AS decline_pct
FROM auth
ORDER BY decline_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM t
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;
